item.title: About
item.description:
About Arun Bharathwaj

I am a Platform Modernization Architect focused on shaping cloud-native solutions that move organisations forward with clarity. My work brings together platform architecture, OpenShift and Kubernetes expertise, and infrastructure automation to make complex technology estates easier to evolve and operate.

My approach is architectural and pragmatic: create a clear path forward, make the secure path the easy path, and leave systems stronger than I found them.

Focus areas

Platform modernizationDeliberate, scalable paths from established estates to cloud-native operations.
Cloud-native solution designPlatform foundations that balance developer experience, reliability and governance.
OpenShift architectureThoughtful cluster, workload, networking and operational design.
Infrastructure automationTerraform, Ansible and delivery workflows that make change repeatable.
Programme deliveryTechnical planning, prioritisation and execution across complex initiatives.
Operational resilienceObservability, security-minded design and dependable day-two operations.

How I work

  • I translate technical complexity into decisions that stakeholders and delivery teams can act on.
  • I bring structured problem-solving, clear communication and calm collaboration to platform change.
  • I align architecture, delivery priorities and operational realities so that progress is sustainable.

Current direction

I continue to deepen my practice across cloud-native solutions design, OpenShift architecture, Azure, Terraform, Ansible and infrastructure automation.
